# ClaroBill

> ClaroBill is an AI-powered medical bill error finder for US healthcare consumers. Users upload a medical bill; ClaroBill analyzes it against 13 deterministic rule checks (duplicate charges, unbundling via NCCI edits, MUE limits, Medicare fee schedule outliers, MRF negotiated-rate ceilings, chargemaster comparisons, effective-dated coding, and more) plus AI review, and returns a plain-English error report with a deterministic citation trail and a ready-to-send dispute letter. Pricing is value-based per bill ($0 to $199.99 based on savings found). ClaroBill is the only consumer tool that compares bills against the hospital's own Machine-Readable File chargemaster in force on the bill's actual service date.
